title: [main] bug 640925 - Enhance draft and proforma invoice report layouts and upgrade tag definitions
summary: Czech localization Draft and Pro Forma Invoice layouts are updated, and an upgrade sets the CZ RDL layouts as default unless a custom layout is selected. Pro Forma Invoice VAT is now calculated from temporary sales lines via SalesPost.GetSalesLines, with non-Item lines filtered out, for correct VAT amounts.
key_points: Pro Forma Invoice RDL layout gains new columns such as TotalLbl and VATIdentifier, with improved alignment
VAT amounts now come from SalesPost.GetSalesLines temporary records with non-Item lines filtered out, which changes the VAT breakdown
Upgrade procedure sets the CZ-specific layouts as default only when no custom selection exists
Upgrade codeunit gets tabledata permissions for Report Layout Selection and Tenant Report Layout Selection
